description:
Read a citation audit that already ran: per prompt and engine, brand cited or named, competitors cited or named, cited URLs; summary rates, the playbook's top actions, a report_url. Asks no engine. (The technical Site Audit is crawl_site.)

Billing: free, at any balance.

When to call: before paying for new checks, to see where competitors are cited instead (list_sites' latest_audit.audit_id); then get_fix_plan. Across all the site's audits: mine_competitor_prompts.

Returns { audit_id, brand, domain, status, engines, prompt_count, competitor_domains, visibility_score, failure_reason, report_url, charged_cents (0), audit_charged_cents (what the run billed), summary: {answered, total, cited, mentioned, citation_rate, mention_rate, branded, non_branded, prompts_lost, by_engine, competitors: [{domain, cited_cells, cited_where_brand_not}], top_cited_domains, top_competitors_mentioned, suggested_competitor_domains, suggested_sources}, do_this_first?: [{priority, title, description, closes_lost_cells, target_hosts, verified, already_done?, evidence?}], results: [{prompt, engines: [{engine, status, cited, mentioned, competitors_cited, competitors_mentioned, urls, answer_excerpt?}]}] }. summary covers every cell; filters narrow only results. branded / non_branded: rates over questions naming / not naming the brand. do_this_first: the playbook's top 3 open actions, re-checked now on the live site (already_done: skip). suggested_competitor_domains: untracked hosts cited instead (confirm before add_site).

include_answers.description: true: add a ~320-char answer_excerpt per cell. Default false.

max_urls.description: Cited URLs listed per cell, 0–50. Default 5; the brand's and competitors' URLs are always listed.

only_lost.description: true: only answered cells where the brand's URL was not cited. Default false.

name: get_audit
title: Read a citation audit's per-prompt, per-engine results
